# Qrzo

Qrzo is a free, bilingual (English / 中文) QR code toolkit that runs entirely in the user's web browser. It generates and decodes QR codes with no upload, no sign-up, and no watermarks.

## What Qrzo does
- Generate scannable QR codes for: URLs, plain text, WiFi credentials, contact cards (vCard), email, SMS, and calendar events (vCalendar).
- Customize QR codes: foreground/background colors, module size, error-correction level (L/M/Q/H), and an optional center logo.
- Download QR codes as high-resolution PNG or scalable SVG.
- Scan and decode any QR image (screenshot or photo) entirely on the device.

## Why it is private
All encoding and decoding happen client-side in JavaScript. The content users enter (links, text, contacts, images) is never uploaded to any server.

## Tools
- URL QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/url-qr.html
- Text QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/text-qr.html
- WiFi QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/wifi-qr.html
- Contact (vCard) QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/vcard-qr.html
- Email QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/email-qr.html
- SMS QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/sms-qr.html
- Event QR: https://qrzo.com/tools/event-qr.html
- QR Scanner & Decoder: https://qrzo.com/tools/qr-scanner.html

## Monetization & affiliations
Qrzo may display advertising via Google AdSense and participates in the Amazon Associates program (tag qrzo-20). These are independent affiliations; the tools themselves are free and do not require payment.
